feature_title: Access Denied (403) Empty State for Lists

rationale.edition: Changed paths span both layers: the OSS shared UI lives under web/src/lib/core (OTable.vue, OTable.types.ts, EmptyState/presets.ts, EmptyLock.vue) plus web/src/components, web/src/views, web/src/composables, web/src/plugins and web/src/locales, while web/src/enterprise/components (OnlineEvals, onlineEvals/*) and web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/* are enterprise-owned. The core `forbidden` prop and `no-access` preset are OSS shared code consumed by both, so edition is 'both'.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. No explicit opt-out is present (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, no `tests-added` label was passed). The change is user-facing: it alters the empty state rendered by ~35 list/table views and several full views (Dashboards, LogStream, RUM SourceMaps, SyntheticMonitoring), so it is not docs-only or CI-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. When a list fetch returns 403 the table now renders a dedicated 'You don't have access' no-access state (lock illustration, no action cards) instead of a misleading first-run 'create your first…' CTA that would itself 403. This is a visible, cross-cutting UI flow (gated by the new `forbidden` prop + `no-access` preset + EmptyLock illustration) that should be verified for at least one representative list and the Dashboards landing path.
rationale.area: GeneralTests. The change is a shared-component behavior (OTable empty-state) rather than one product area; it touches alerts, functions, IAM, pipelines, queries, reports, settings, synthetic monitoring, workflows, dashboards and streams. There is no IAM/RBAC testfolder, and GeneralTests already hosts IAM/settings specs (serviceAccount.spec.js, cipherKeys.spec.js, etc.), making it the natural home for a cross-cutting access/empty-state spec.
rationale.group: GeneralTests is the closest existing testfolder shard. Note: this repo has no plain ci_matrix.json — the OSS env matrix is tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix_env.json, whose GeneralTests group (actual_folder GeneralTests) is the fit. The Engineer must add noAccessState.spec.js to that group's run_files.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff — nothing under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ changed. The only test file is web/src/views/Dashboards/Dashboards.spec.ts, a Vitest unit test, which is unit coverage (dev test-maintenance) and not Playwright E2E, so existing_tests_in_diff is false.
